description:
Senior Java Fullstack Developer (m/f/d) – Romania

Join Fairsource as we expand into Romania and bring a new, fairer way of working to the IT consulting industry!

About Fairsource

Fairsource is an innovative German software consulting company built on a simple but powerful idea: fairness, transparency, and shared success.

What makes us different? Our unique business model ensures that the majority of the revenue generated through our projects goes directly to the full-time experts who deliver them. We believe that the people creating the value should receive a fair share of it.

We help companies in Germany successfully deliver their software projects by providing experienced IT professionals who bring the expertise, flexibility, and technical excellence they need.

At the same time, we offer our experts something truly different: the opportunity to work on exciting projects, continuously develop their skills, enjoy greater professional freedom, and receive compensation that genuinely reflects their contribution.

Exciting News: Fairsource Is Expanding to Romania!

We are thrilled to bring the Fairsource concept to Romania!

As we expand internationally, we are looking for talented and experienced software engineers who want to be part of this exciting new chapter.

This is more than just another software development position. It's an opportunity to join a growing company that challenges traditional IT consulting models and puts its people first.

Be among the first to join Fairsource in Romania and help us build something exceptional!

Your Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement modern, scalable web applications using Java for backend development and modern frontend technologies such as Angular, Vue.js, or React.

  • Design and implement microservices and APIs.

  • Build new software solutions and enhance existing applications.

  • Contribute to software architecture and technical design decisions.

  • Conduct code reviews and ensure high standards of code quality.

  • Integrate databases and ensure data integrity.

  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines.

  • Work with leading cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

  • Ensure application performance, security, and scalability.

  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation.

Your Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 6 years of professional experience as a Java Fullstack Developer.

  • Strong knowledge of Spring Framework, Enterprise Java, or Quarkus.

  • Experience with microservices and software architecture.

  • Proficiency in at least one modern frontend framework: Angular, Vue.js, or React.

  • Solid understanding of CI/CD, Test-Driven Development (TDD), and Clean Code principles.

  • Initial hands-on experience with technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Experience working with SQL or NoSQL databases.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in collaborative, cross-functional teams.

What Makes Fairsource Different?

We believe great software engineers deserve more than just a competitive salary and interesting projects. They deserve transparency, flexibility, recognition, and a genuine share in the value they create.

Our Benefits

  • Exceptional earning potential: Earn an above-market salary thanks to our transparent revenue-sharing model, where the majority of the revenue you generate goes directly to you.

  • Freedom and flexibility: Have a say in the projects you work on, manage your workload, and enjoy greater control over your working days and time off.

  • Exciting projects: Work on diverse, challenging software projects for companies in Germany.

  • Professional development: Benefit from excellent training opportunities, continuous learning, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

  • A strong engineering community: Collaborate with talented colleagues, exchange knowledge, and learn from each other.

  • Conferences and meetups: We encourage you to share your expertise, participate in tech events, and become an active member of the developer community.

  • Team events: Enjoy regular opportunities to connect, collaborate, and celebrate with your colleagues.

  • Transparency and trust: Be part of a company where fairness is not just a corporate value but the foundation of our business model.

Why Join Fairsource Romania?

We are not simply expanding into a new market. We are bringing a different approach to IT consulting to Romania.

Our goal is to create an environment where experienced software engineers can thrive professionally and financially while enjoying the freedom and respect they deserve.

By joining Fairsource Romania at this exciting stage, you'll become part of our international growth journey and help establish a community of highly skilled professionals who believe in a fairer future for software consulting.

Your expertise creates value. At Fairsource, you deserve to share in that value.

Ready to Be Part of Something Different?

Are you an experienced Java Fullstack Developer looking for more freedom, transparency, exciting projects, and compensation that truly reflects your skills?

We would love to hear from you!

Join Fairsource Romania and discover what fair IT consulting really means.
